items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: But it was originally on Supreme. Now, their biggest hit was from a girl by the name of Paula Watson. She made a record called 'The Little Bird Told Me.'

ctx.x: Yeah, in London. And he's got the black Lion, uh-huh. That's -- but it was originally on Supreme. Now, their biggest hit was from a girl by the name of Paula Watson. She made a record called 'The Little Bird Told Me.' They sold a million copies with her. And Vic did some things for them, but the biggest thing, their biggest record, was with Paula.
So now, you left the band in '50.
